# Support

For help with a MrewyOrg project, start with that repository's README, documentation, and support
instructions.

- For Botge setup and usage, see the [wiki](https://github.com/MrewyOrg/Botge/wiki) or ask in
  [Discussions](https://github.com/MrewyOrg/Botge/discussions).
- Report bugs and request features in the affected repository's issue tracker. Search existing
  issues first and include the version, reproduction steps, and relevant logs without secrets.
- For this organization profile or shared community files, open an issue in
  [MrewyOrg/.github](https://github.com/MrewyOrg/.github/issues).

Please use English. For vulnerabilities, follow the affected project's security policy.
